Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the clear agenda. I need to flag an internal change: our CTO just greenlit an accelerated platform migration (vendor consolidation + replatforming to Snowdrop infra) and the finance team has put a temporary freeze on new pilot spend until the migration plan is clearer. On top of that, Rajiv and a couple of execs are traveling the next two weeks.

Given that mix, leadership has asked us to pause all new external pilots that require cross-team time. Were not closing the door on Redwood — the infra and inference work is still on the roadmap — but the timing has shifted out of this quarter. Can we put the demo on hold and reconvene early next quarter?

If it's helpful, I'm happy to share a short one-pager on what's changing internally so you have the context for when we reschedule.

Apologies for the short notice — we wanted to surface this quickly rather than ghost the invite.

Best,
